messages:
lana_ae: Quick question from the Acme POC — they asked for explicit evidence on logging/monitoring for the trial. Three asks: 1) how to integrate with their SIEM, 2) what retention we provide for a POC vs prod, and 3) examples of admin activity/audit trails. Can we share a short config + retention commitments?

sam_se: Yep. Short summary: we emit three categories of logs: inference telemetry (per-request ids, latencies, tokens), control-plane audit (model deploys, config changes, rollouts), and infra/agent logs (syslog, container stdout). For hosted POC we keep full logs for 90 days by default; Dedicated/Private customers can request 365+ days and customer-managed KMS. Exports: S3 batch export or real-time push via TLS syslog/HEC to Splunk/Datadog/QRadar. Internal integration doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/siem-integration (will PM access).

olivia_infosec: To add: control-plane audit trails contain actor, action, object, timestamp, source IP, and request id. Audit logs are append-only and HMAC-signed at rest. For Dedicated/Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS/HSM, RBAC controls, and per-admin IAM mapping. SOC2/ISO artifacts reference logging controls — see compliance pack: https://redwood.internal/compliance/logging-evidence

ben_support: For the POC I can share a small runbook + sample Fluentd/rsyslog configs to push events to Splunk HEC or upload to S3 for their SIEM to ingest. Need to confirm if Acme prefers pull (we ship daily S3 bundles) or push (we open outbound to their HEC). Also need IP whitelist and a service account.

sam_se: sample config (excerpt):
```
# fluentd -> splunk HEC
<match **>
  @type splunk_hec
  endpoint https://splunk.acme.example:8088
  token xxxxx-REDACTED
  tls true
</match>

# or S3 upload with rotation
<match **>
  @type s3
  aws_key_id YOUR_KEY
  aws_sec_key YOUR_SECRET
  s3_bucket redwood-poc-logs-1748450000
  path logs/%Y/%m/%d/
</match>
```

lana_ae: Thanks — regarding the retention commitment: can we guarantee 90 days for hosted POC in writing? Customer asked for a note they can include in their vendor review.

olivia_infosec: For hosted POCs we can commit to a 90-day retention and provide HMAC-verified exports on request within that window. For enterprise deals we typically add an addendum that extends retention or pins data residency to Dedicated/Private. Note: admin activity logging retention is 365 days by default on Dedicated. I can draft a short statement for legal.

ben_support: I'll assemble the POC runbook (steps, sample configs, required IPs/ports, expected events list) and drop a redacted example creds and the runbook link here in ~10m. Also will include the lifecycle policy we apply to S3 exports.

deploybot: POC-logs-bucket created: redwood-poc-logs-1748450000 :white_check_mark:

lana_ae: Great — please drop the runbook + dummy creds in thread and I'll forward to Acme. :thumbsup:

sam_se: Sending PM with doc access now and will attach the runbook to #tenants-docs. Will follow up if Acme wants a live demo of the stream into their Splunk instance.
